title: AC1032 DXF HEADER boolean group-code normalization and DWG flag encoding

source.kind: locally generated AC1032 DXF and direct HEADER encoder controls

changes: HEADER writer validation accepts group 70 values retained from DWG flag decoding and, for AC2010+ targets, group 290 values already present in modern DXF input.
AC2010+ HEADER emission normalizes EXTNAMES, PSTYLEMODE, and OLESTARTUP to group 290.
DWG packed HEADER flag composition accepts either the legacy group-70 or modern DXF group-290 representation for these three boolean values, while unrelated group codes remain invalid.
The AC1032 CLI contract asserts the emitted group-290 code and expected value for all three variables, then imports and rewrites the resulting file.
scope.affectedPlanScope: P6-F HEADER per-version behavior; does not close HEADER envelope/suffix accounting, broader version coverage, external producer qualification, or P6-G writer inventory.

reproduction.before: Locally generated AC1032 DXF readback failed during HEADER emission because EXTNAMES, PSTYLEMODE, and OLESTARTUP were emitted as group 290 but preflight required group 70.
reproduction.after: AC1032 output uses the expected group-290 booleans and the generated output can be imported and rewritten successfully.

dwgFlagEncoding.modernGroup290: Generated group-290 EXTNAMES/PSTYLEMODE/OLESTARTUP values compose to the expected DWG flag bits.
dwgFlagEncoding.wrongGroupCode: A group-280 OLESTARTUP value is rejected.

limits: Generated controls establish writer normalization, DWG flag composition, and self-readback only; they do not establish independent producer behavior or native consumer qualification.
No DWG/DXF fixture file was added or modified.
The broader DWG reader matrix contains unrelated pre-existing failures and was not used as a passing result.
